data.body: A section is a reusable content block a page renders — prose, heroes, grids, CTAs. Shared sections are referenced from multiple pages by id; editing the object updates every page that references it.

Body fields

  • tracking
  • section (required)

Patch operations

  • upsert_section
  • update_section_data
  • set_section_visibility
  • set_tracking

This reference is generated from the live object_contract. If it disagrees with the contract, the manual is wrong and the drift guard fails the build of it.

Worked example

sec_dtc_launch_readiness is a shared comparison table referenced by both the architecture page and DTC example. One section edit can update every referencing page after publication.

Lifecycle note

A shared section wraps one standalone-placeable component and cannot point at another shared section.
